_description: earth_moon_hero — poster 'blue marble' shot. Textured Earth fills the frame, the textured Moon smaller and set back to camera-left, against the starfield Milky Way environment. A single hard sun key from camera-right carves a crisp day/night terminator on both bodies.

lights._comment: hard sun key, high camera-LEFT-front so the lit day side faces the camera, crisp terminator on the right limb
